reviews.x: These are very nice! My husband has used them on his callused heels everyday since we got them( his feet are so soft now). They take a bit of getting used to, if you are or have been using the man made pumice stones. But in the end they work like a charm and get the job done. Oh, and so far I can't say that I have had the issue of them falling apart like some of the other reviews.

Bought these for myself. Both had different sized bubbles and we're completely unique (exactly what you'd expect from a rock). Some other reviewers complained of these coming broken or breaking shortly after purchasing. Thus far, I have only opened one and have used it every single day in the shower and it has worked wonders for my feet, mainly my heels, which become dry and Crack badly. I love these, and for the price of two it was more than well worth it.

reviews.t: I really liked that as the picture shows the two stones I ...
reviews.x: I really liked that as the picture shows the two stones I received have different sizes of holes/pitting. I have only used one thus far (for my feet) and I am really happy with the quality and the effectiveness of these stones. There was a little dust in them from shipping but they came intact and work well.
The rocks seemed to get smooth rather quickly!

reviews.t: I used it twice on my feet in the first ...
reviews.x: I used it twice on my feet in the first week I had it. After using it I rinsed it clean. It s-t-u-n-k at the end of the week. I couldn't pin point the odor in the bathroom at first. Then I realized it was coming from the pumice. Then I threw it out and also the unused one. That's my experience unfortunately. I'd rather be writing a positive review. Next time I'll stick with the more common light grey, light weight, rectangular one.
Came much earlier than expected! It does in fact come with 2. I love this product! great quality, size does vary. Feels like real rock to me! My feet are silky smooth now!
very ackward to use/hold, perhaps a little to big for my liking

reviews.t: Might be worth the money, but the stones are a different size for some reason
reviews.x: I actually bought these because I got my first Syrian Hamster, and needed a way to trim his nails. I placed these underneath his water bottles in hopes that it'll do some good. I poured very hot water over them to sterilize, then let it air dry on a towel for at least a full day.  I decided to pick this particular one because it was a "two pack" and I'll probably use the second one for myself (I bought another "buy one get one" pumice stone at the same time to compare)  The...bub

reviews.t: Great Product at a Great Price!
reviews.x: I have been looking for a REAL pumice stone (not like the ones found in stores) that actually works.  This helps get all the rough, dry skin on my feet and is making them soft again.  I have experienced very little to ZERO 'sandy grit' other than when opening the package. If you are looking for a great pumice stone, this is it!!!  Really great product!

Very happy with these stones. Instead of using a loofa I use the stone to wash my body in combination with organic coconut soap bar. Leaves my skin smooth and clean. It takes a while to get used to it specially around sensitive areas around your body but its worth the clean, fresh feeling.

I bought these for my husband and I who CrossFit 4x/week. They work significantly better than the normal pumice stones, the ones that are like stone dust glued together into a brick. Perfect for using daily to keep callouses on hands and fingers at bay.

If you're expecting these to slough away dead skin or soften rough feet, think again. I soaked my feet in hot water for 30 minutes, and these did next to nothing. Tried again the next day, same result. The joke's on me.
The product arrived ontime, and as described. I haven't used these pumice stones yet. I would order from this stller again.

reviews.t: this starting to stink in my shower a few weeks ...
reviews.x: this starting to stink in my shower a few weeks after purchase.  Don't know what caused the stench, but yuck!
I might as well have broken off a chunk of concrete and rubbed it against my foot.
The stones are the size of a bar of soap. Which makes them easy to hold.

Ok, so I didn't but these for my skin or whatever you're supposed to do with these lol I actually purchased them for my fish aquarium to be anchored by fishing line with the intention that they could be wrapped with various plants and create a floating island type of look. Out of the 4 that I received, only 1 of them floated. Lol that's how it goes though but that's why they get three stars from me. Didn't exactly meet my expectations but I am not using them for their intended use I suppose. Gir

reviews.t: Not sure this is an actual pumice
reviews.x: Sure they look the part, but I'm pretty sure these are just some kind of painted concrete. The 2 I received are quite different from one another. One with bigger holes only on one side and pretty smooth on the other. The other was pretty much smooth with no bigger holes at all. For a "pumice" stone they are very heavy like rocks. And I'm not sure why they are painted brown as it comes off in the water or on your feet. I've left it on my soap holder in the shower and had a big brown strea

reviews.t: The best you can buy! The best for your buck!
reviews.x: Best pumice stone I could find. With my type 2 diabetes foot care is very important. I've gone through multiple other products. Nothing works as well at exfoliating than these all natural stones.  Update 12/2016: They last and last. I haven't had them wear down at all over the past several months. I use them daily in the shower. I just ordered more for Christmas stocking stuffers. Great product!

These work really well but you need to be careful to not scrub too hard as you could easily take off more skin than intended when removing callouses since they are so effective.  As the description says, they are a natural product so the holes vary in size quite a bit but as long as you use common sense and go slow until you get used to your exact stones they work great.

I have had these stones for 2 years, haven't even got around to using the second yet, because the first is still amazing. Some spots are rougher than others, smooth spots can even be used on the face gently. Fantastic for removing dead skin before shaving legs etc. As described it will shed a little when first used, but will soon be solid and lasting.

I don't know what a few reviewers mean by there being a "smell" coming from the stones.  I have used mine 3 times so far and haven't been able to smell anything.  They work great, are a good size and are just the right amount of roughness to get the job done.  I made a good purchase.

reviews.t: GREAT FOR PEOPLE WITH PRETTY FEET
reviews.x: I usually buy my pumice stone from Cost Plus but, I think they are actually made of clay.  My feet are so bad that I'm probably not the best to qualify but, if your feet are really callused go with something a bit more durable.

These are amazing my feet are so soft.  Only thing is be aware that they tell you because of the type of rock they are they will release a little red color but no worries it wipes right of with regular water and paper towel.

reviews.t: These work great for callouses on my feet from running
reviews.x: There are great for my feet. All natural and good price. I recommend these over synthetic pumice stones. Just use the smoother one first and don't be too aggressive. Just a little pressure will remove callouses.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the stones effective at softening feet and smoothing skin, with several calling them better than standard pumice stones.
Some reviewers report the stones develop an unpleasant odor after use.
A few reviewers complain the stones wear down or become smooth too quickly, or fail to remove dead skin.
Several reviewers note the two stones vary in size and texture, which some appreciate as natural and others find inconsistent.
Some reviewers find the stones awkward or too big to hold, or too rough on the skin.
